scope: Public-upstream Lean environment sources and local build requirements. Historical execution reports are maintained separately from the source distribution.
distribution_scope: Each dependency retains its own license. Retain corresponding source, copyright and license notices when distributing binaries. A local build or successful run does not authorize redistribution of every component.
network_scope: Build-time upstream retrieval uses the declared build network. Runtime connectivity follows each task configuration.
product_identity: Historical image IDs remain distinct from local products; do not relabel historical products with current build signatures.
